definitions.consortia: Taxa whose direct project tags at first GoaT observation all map to a named coordinated programme in the curated list.
definitions.small_groups: Proxy only: taxa with one direct project tag not mapped to a named consortium or institutional programme. This does not verify team size.
definitions.excluded: Missing tags, institutional programmes, and mixed or multi-project records that do not map wholly to consortia are not assigned to either comparison group. Each taxon is counted once.
